user.title: Add panel
user.description: Set up a new HomeTiles panel.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Panel discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: **{name}** ({model}) was found on the network at {host}. HomeTiles Bridge will send the MQTT credentials below to the panel; it will then restart. Host and port are prefilled automatically. Enter username and password if your MQTT broker requires login credentials.

data.panel_password: Panel Web Admin password (only if set)

data_description.panel_password: Leave empty if the panel has no Web Admin password. It is used only for this pairing and is not stored.

discovery_confirm.title: Panel discovered
discovery_confirm.description: **{name}** announced itself over MQTT with base topic {base_topic}. Only add it if it is your panel.

adopt_confirm.title: Link panel
adopt_confirm.description: **{name}** announced itself over MQTT with base topic {base_topic}, which the entry **{entry}** uses. Only link it if it is your panel.

pairing_confirm.title: Pair display
pairing_confirm.description:
**{name}** wants to pair with the Bridge.

Number: **{number}**

Only confirm if the display shows exactly this number right now, then confirm on the display too. Once paired, the Bridge runs only encrypted commands from this display.

error.topic_already_configured: A panel with this MQTT topic is already configured.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the panel. Check that it's still on the network and try again.
error.mqtt_host_required: Enter an MQTT host or IP address.
error.invalid_port: Enter a valid MQTT port between 1 and 65535.
error.invalid_panel_password: The panel rejected the Web Admin password.
error.panel_password_required: The panel's Web Admin is protected by a password. Enter the Web Admin password.
error.panel_locked: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.panel_identity_failed: The device could not prove that it is the panel with this password. No credentials were sent.

abort.missing_device_id: The discovered device did not send a valid identifier.
abort.mqtt_not_configured: No MQTT integration is set up in Home Assistant. Please set up the MQTT integration first.
abort.unsupported_broker: The configured MQTT broker requires TLS or a client certificate, which the panel does not support. Please enter the broker credentials manually in the panel's web interface.
abort.mqtt_read_failed: Could not read the MQTT credentials.
abort.panel_linked: The panel was linked to the existing entry.
abort.adopt_target_changed: The entry now belongs to another panel or uses another base topic.
abort.pairing_done: Paired. The display now sends its commands encrypted.
abort.pairing_confirmed: Confirmed. Now confirm the number on the display too.
abort.pairing_rejected: Pairing rejected. The display stays unencrypted.
abort.pairing_expired: This pairing attempt has ended (cancelled or older than 2 minutes). Start pairing again on the display.

entities.title: Entity configuration
entities.description: Applies to all displays. Switchable entities: switch, input_boolean, automation, fan, humidifier, remote and siren. Automations are enabled/disabled. Scenes and scripts are started; buttons and input buttons are pressed once.

energy.title: Energy Dashboard
energy.description: Send data from the Home Assistant Energy Dashboard to devices.

security.title: Encrypted commands
security.description:
This display is paired (key id {key_id}). The Bridge runs only encrypted commands from it, and camera stream tokens travel encrypted as well. States and camera images stay unencrypted.

To remove the pairing, tick the box. The display turns encryption off by itself as soon as it is connected to the Bridge.

error.invalid_scene_map: Aliases must follow the pattern alias=entity_id (one per line).
error.invalid_editable_entities: Choose compatible Number, Select or Date/Time entities.
error.pairing_nothing_selected: Nothing was changed. To remove the pairing, tick the box.

abort.pairing_removed: Pairing removed. The Bridge runs unencrypted commands from this display again. The display turns encryption off by itself as soon as it is connected to the Bridge.
abort.pairing_not_paired: This display is not paired. To pair it, choose Settings → System → Security → Pair on the display. Home Assistant then shows a card under Discovered with a six-digit number to compare.
abort.pairing_removing: The pairing is removed. The display turns encryption off by itself as soon as it is connected to the Bridge; its unencrypted commands already work.

view_unavailable.message: The display is offline or its view catalog is not ready.

invalid_view.message: The selected view no longer exists.
